projects.title: 2D Platformer
projects.tagline: Tight controls, escalating levels, satisfying jumps.
projects.description: A 2D side-scrolling platformer focused on responsive movement and game feel. Built player movement, jumping and collision systems, then layered in multi-level progression with audio.
highlights: Developed player movement, jumping and collision using Rigidbody2D and BoxCollider2D
Designed multiple levels with increasing difficulty, sound effects and background music
Improved gameplay feel using physics and smooth character movement mechanics

projects.title: 3D Racing
projects.description: A 3D racing game built around believable vehicle handling and competitive AI. Implemented wheel physics, opponent logic and lap systems, then optimized the scene for smooth frame rates.
highlights: Built vehicle controls and wheel physics using WheelCollider
Implemented AI opponents, lap tracking and leaderboard systems
Optimized scene performance by reducing draw calls and improving rendering efficiency

projects.title: Endless Runner
projects.tagline: Procedural obstacles, adaptive difficulty, high-score chase.
projects.description: An endless runner engineered for performance and replayability. Used object pooling for dynamic obstacle spawning, scaled difficulty to player skill, and built a full responsive UI loop.
highlights: Created dynamic obstacle spawning using object pooling
Added adaptive difficulty based on player score and progression
Developed responsive UI: score tracking, high-score saving and restart system
